class B, unit al-hamra, unit muscat

unit al-hamra: 3 min (fajr).reason: The ministry computes Al Hamra's table about two thirds of a degree north of the town, and Taqwa keeps the town's own later dawn in early summer

unit al-hamra: 3 min (sunrise).reason: The sunrise shown is never after the real sunrise at the place itself (ruling R265), and the ministry's printed sunrise stands after the sun has risen there on some days: the sunrise comes up to 3 min before the print

unit bahla: 3 min.reason: Al Hamra's table, which the ministry computes about two thirds of a degree north of that town, also holds the north of Bahla's area, and there Taqwa keeps the later start and the earlier end of the two tables in summer

unit muscat: 3 min.reason: The sunrise shown is never after the real sunrise at the place itself (ruling R265), and the ministry's printed sunrise stands after the sun has risen there on some days: the sunrise comes up to 3 min before the print
